title.narrative: HTI-C-PSI - Haiti (01-Nov-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Haiti, TB/HIV, Population Services International (PSI HQ)This program has the following goals: By 2018, increase from 76% to 95% the survival rate for adults and children living with HIV under ARV, 12 months after initiating TARV. By 2018, stabilize at 2% the HIV seroprevalance among adults aged 15-49. By 2019, reduce morbidity by 10% and mortality by 15% caused by tuberculosis. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: By 2017, increase to at least 85% the proportion of key populations at higher risk of HIV who have low-risk behaviour and sexual practices. Objective 2: By 2017, ensure 100% coverageof sero-positive pregnant women and children born to sero-positive mothers through the set of services aimed at reducing mother-to-child transmission. Objective 3: By 2017, increase to at least 80% the proportion of adults and children living with HIV availing of medical, psychological and social health care. Objective 4: Maintain the therapeutic success rate for PTB+ and PTB- at 85% between now and the end of 2019. Objective 5: Increase the proportion of MDR-TB cases that are diagnosed and treated from 58% to 85% of expected cases between now and the end of 2019. Objective 6: By 2018, contribute to strengthening the health care system
